programs.summary: Crypto prepaid Mastercard from 1inch, powered by Crypto Life and developed with Baanx. Current 1inch terms identify Monavate Limited as issuer while users can spend supported crypto through conversion to fiat.

Kraken Mastercard debit card launched for eligible UK and EEA customers in July 2026, allowing spending from supported crypto and fiat balances with conversion at purchase time. Monavate is the evidenced issuer, with the legal entity varying between UK and EEA disclosures.

U.S.-only Coinbase One credit card for eligible paid Coinbase One members. The current product is offered through Coinbase and Cardless, issued by First Electronic Bank, and runs on the American Express network; it is distinct from the Coinbase debit-card program.

providers.summary: U.S. bank identified by Coinbase as issuer of the Coinbase One Card.
Card platform identified by Coinbase as a company through which the Coinbase One Card is offered. The reviewed Coinbase disclosure does not assign Cardless the regulated issuer role.
Global card network used by the Coinbase One Card under licence from American Express.

relations.scope_note: Current 1inch terms identify the 1inch CL Card as a prepaid Mastercard issued by Monavate Limited.
1inch launch and current terms identify Mastercard as the card network.
1inch identifies Crypto Life as powering the 1inch Card.
Current 1inch card documentation describes the product as developed in partnership with Baanx; no issuer role is assigned to Baanx here.

Kraken identifies Monavate Limited as UK issuer and UAB Monavate as EEA issuer. The existing Monavate provider record is reused while the jurisdiction-specific legal-entity wording is preserved in evidence and scope.
Kraken's launch and product pages identify Kraken Card as Mastercard debit card.
Coinbase's current Coinbase One Card disclosure identifies First Electronic Bank as issuer.
Coinbase states the Coinbase One Card is offered through Coinbase, Inc. and Cardless, Inc. No regulated issuer role is assigned to Cardless.
Coinbase identifies American Express as the network for the Coinbase One Card.

events.title: 1inch announces 1inch Card
events.description: 1inch announced its Web3 debit card with Mastercard and Crypto Life on April 8, 2024. Current legal terms identify Monavate Limited as issuer and Baanx as part of the provider stack.

events.title: Kraken Card launches in UK and EEA
events.description: Kraken announced Kraken Card live for eligible customers across the UK and EEA, supporting spending from crypto and cash balances through Mastercard with Monavate issuance.

events.title: Coinbase announces Coinbase One Card for U.S. members
events.description: Coinbase announced the Coinbase One Card as its first credit card, planned for U.S. Coinbase One members on the American Express network. The date is an announcement milestone, not asserted as general-availability launch; current Coinbase pages separately establish that the card is now active.

unresolved: Exact Coinbase One Card general-availability launch date is not asserted because the reviewed first-party sources establish the 2025-06-12 announcement and current active state but not a precise GA date.
